name: ambulance-traffic-alert
description: Warns traffic officers ~60 s / 500 m before an ambulance reaches their junction. No signal hardware needed.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
